plan.p0: Identify the dominant background color, the marker color 2, and the remaining non-background color. The remaining color forms a seed pattern on one border; the 2s lie on an adjacent border. Preserve the grid size and all marker cells.
plan.p1: Propagate the seed pattern from its border across the grid, parallel to that border. Scan columns or rows toward the opposite side. Each encountered 2-marker increases the seed's displacement by one cell away from the marker border.
plan.p2: For every copied seed cell, calculate its coordinate after the cumulative displacement caused by markers already crossed. Paint valid destinations with the seed color, leaving the background elsewhere. Keep the original 2 markers unchanged and clip shifted cells outside the grid.
plan.p3: Choose scan direction from the two detected borders: move across columns when the seed is on a left/right edge, or across rows when it is on a top/bottom edge. Validate by reproducing the observed pair, especially the staircase shifts after each bottom-edge marker.
